title: From Qualitative Text to Integrated Evidence: The Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI) Procedure
abstract: arXiv:2610.19164v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixed methods research offers established strategies for integrating qualitative and quantitative evidence, but less guidance for integrating two computational representations of the same qualitative corpus. This methodological study introduces Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI), a four-step procedure for explicit and traceable integration. We present PTI using 1,203 interview paragraphs from 29 mothers in Nepal. The two representations were ontology-guided Patient Voice (PV) coding with PVminer and data-driven themes generated through non-negative matrix factorization (NMF). Depression status, based on Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) scores, served as a secondary external anchor for exploratory association checks. translated_title: 从定性文本到整合证据：平行-后整合（PTI）程序
translated_abstract: 混合方法研究为整合定性与定量证据提供了成熟的策略，但对于整合同一定性语料库的两种计算表征则缺乏指导。这项方法学研究提出了“平行-后整合”（Parallel-Then-Integrated, PTI），一种用于显式且可追溯整合的四步程序。我们使用来自尼泊尔29位母亲的1,203个访谈段落来展示PTI。这两种表征分别是以本体论为指导、借助PVminer工具进行的患者声音（Patient Voice, PV）编码，以及通过非负矩阵分解（NMF）生成的数据驱动主题。一个“主题-完整”对照表记录了两者之间的趋同、分歧以及对预处理敏感的差异。基于患者健康问卷-9（PHQ-9）评分的抑郁状态作为探索性关联检验的次级外部锚点。PTI为在混合方法研究中整合定性文本的计算表征提供了一种结构化的方法。
tldr: 本文提出了PTI（平行-后整合）这一四步程序，用于在混合方法研究中显式且可追溯地整合同一定性语料库的两种计算表征（本体论指导的PV编码与NMF数据驱动主题），并以尼泊尔母亲的访谈数据和PHQ-9抑郁评分作为外部锚点加以演示。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Parallel-Then-Integrated (PTI) procedure, a four-step method for explicitly and traceably integrating two computational representations of the same qualitative corpus—ontology-guided Patient Voice coding and NMF-derived themes—within mixed methods research, demonstrated using interview data from Nepali mothers with PHQ-9 depression scores as an external anchor.
